description: Categorical negative log likelihood after dividing class logits by a positive scalar temperature, following Guo et al. §4.2, Eq. (9) and §3, Eq. (6); callers supply or fit temperature on held-out validation data with the classifier fixed.

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    features = torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": int(features[:3].argmax())}
ds = synth.Spec("temperature-scaling-classification", generator=samples, size=16, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
model = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=3)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "temperature-scaling", "loss_kwargs": {"temperature": 1.0}}, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a classifier with temperature-scaled NLL

name: Temperature scaling loss

parameters.ignore_index: optional integer class index to exclude from loss (default None)
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point class logits with shape [B, K]
parameters.reduction: none per sample, mean over valid samples, or sum (default mean)
parameters.targets: long tensor of class indices with shape [B]
parameters.temperature: positive finite scalar divisor applied to logits before log-softmax (default 1.0)
